rounds.summary: Full visual redesign: design language, shadows, spacing, type.
Restructure the page into semantic sections and go responsive.
Rebuild the order form on a validation framework with inline errors.
Cinematic hero image with gradient overlay.
Motion framework: scroll reveals, hover states, transitions.
Ship a UI component library (buttons, cards, chips, modals).
A tiny state manager so widgets share one source of truth.
Theming system with runtime theme switching.
Full-bleed video hero with sound-off poster frame.
Micro-interactions everywhere: magnetic buttons, ripples, toasts.
PWA: manifest + service worker for offline menu browsing.
First-party analytics module with funnel events.
Bold differentiator: an interactive pumpkin-carving configurator for the season.
Design tokens extracted to their own layer.
Live order board (websocket stub with graceful fallback).
In-repo test harness for the form validators.
Content layer: menu data in JSON with a loader.
Account UI stub with sign-in sheet.
Charts on canvas for weekly orders.
Language toggle, now wired to a real control in the nav.
Booking system for the tasting room.
Blog comments with moderation queue stub.
Keep the stable order-form id; alias it in JS instead.
